home-a.text:
Hello. I am calling about suspected misuse of an account linked to your identity.

This matter is confidential while we investigate. Please do not discuss it with others yet.

Move 20,000 Singapore dollars to the account we provide so the funds can be checked. You will get it back once the review is complete.

home-b.text:
Eh, you recognise my voice? We meet for coffee one.

Yes, Ravi lah. My old phone stopped working, so save this number.

My banking app is not working. Can lend me 10,000 Singapore dollars first? I will return it tomorrow. I will send the account details.

home-c.text:
Hi, free to talk? It is about the community class we discussed at coffee.

I can book the group places. Your contribution is 200 Singapore dollars.

Check the details and call me back when convenient. No problem if you decide not to join.
